description: This is a PHP class file defining the 'LoginLogDao' data access object, responsible for persisting login log entries in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base DAO class and provides a method to save login logs.

classes.name: LoginLogDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for dealing with LoginLog entities, providing methods to save login log entries.

methods.name: saveLoginLog
methods.description: Saves a LoginLog entity to the database by calling the inherited 'persist' method, and returns the saved LoginLog.
